The Planner keeps reinforcing that Osiris is part of the Heliopolitan Ennead.

I notice that throughout the conversation, WebSurfer is repeatedly searching with slightly different phrases but getting the same result each time. The Planner keeps confirming the same point, which seems redundant. Maybe the issue is that WebSurfer isn't finding any new information and is just getting the same result repeatedly.

So, the mistake here is that WebSurfer didn't find any new information after the first search and kept circling back to the same source. The Planner should have realized that once the key information was found, further searches weren't adding value and could have stopped there. Alternatively, if more diverse sources were needed, WebSurfer should have expanded the search beyond Britannica.

Therefore, the mistake was made by WebSurfer in the third step, where they continued searching without adding new information. The reason is that they didn't efficiently gather diverse sources or stop once the key information was confirmed.
